name: url
label: URL
help: The base URL of your self-hosted OpenObserve instance, **including the scheme** (`http://` or `https://`), without a trailing slash or port — the port is set separately below.

pattern.message: Enter just the scheme and host, e.g. http://openobserve.example.com, with no path or port. The port is set separately below.

name: port
label: Port
help: The port your OpenObserve instance listens on.

name: apiKey
label: API Key
help: The full HTTP Basic Authorization value for your organization — sent through unmodified as `Authorization: Basic <this value>`. This is the already base64-encoded `username:password` (or `username:token`) pair, not a plain password or token. Paste it exactly as given to you — it is not re-encoded.

name: ignoreCertificateErrors
label: Ignore certificate errors
help: Enable when connecting to an instance with a self-signed certificate.
